h: Package utf8 implements functions and constants to support text encoded in UTF-8. It includes functions to translate between runes and UTF-8 byte sequences. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTF-8

AppendRune.h: AppendRune appends the UTF-8 encoding of r to the end of p and returns the extended buffer. If the rune is out of range, it appends the encoding of RuneError.

DecodeLastRune.h:
DecodeLastRune unpacks the last UTF-8 encoding in p and returns the rune and its width in bytes. If p is empty it returns (RuneError, 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1). Both are impossible results for correct, non-empty UTF-8.

An encoding is invalid if it is incorrect UTF-8, encodes a rune that is out of range, or is not the shortest possible UTF-8 encoding for the value. No other validation is performed.

DecodeLastRuneInString.s: func utf8.DecodeLastRuneInString(s string) (r rune, size int)
DecodeLastRuneInString.h:
DecodeLastRuneInString is like DecodeLastRune but its input is a string. If s is empty it returns (RuneError, 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1). Both are impossible results for correct, non-empty UTF-8.

An encoding is invalid if it is incorrect UTF-8, encodes a rune that is out of range, or is not the shortest possible UTF-8 encoding for the value. No other validation is performed.

DecodeRune.h:
DecodeRune unpacks the first UTF-8 encoding in p and returns the rune and its width in bytes. If p is empty it returns (RuneError, 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1). Both are impossible results for correct, non-empty UTF-8.

An encoding is invalid if it is incorrect UTF-8, encodes a rune that is out of range, or is not the shortest possible UTF-8 encoding for the value. No other validation is performed.

DecodeRuneInString.s: func utf8.DecodeRuneInString(s string) (r rune, size int)
DecodeRuneInString.h:
DecodeRuneInString is like DecodeRune but its input is a string. If s is empty it returns (RuneError, 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1). Both are impossible results for correct, non-empty UTF-8.

An encoding is invalid if it is incorrect UTF-8, encodes a rune that is out of range, or is not the shortest possible UTF-8 encoding for the value. No other validation is performed.

EncodeRune.h: EncodeRune writes into p (which must be large enough) the UTF-8 encoding of the rune. If the rune is out of range, it writes the encoding of RuneError. It returns the number of bytes written.

FullRune.h: FullRune reports whether the bytes in p begin with a full UTF-8 encoding of a rune. An invalid encoding is considered a full Rune since it will convert as a width-1 error rune.

FullRuneInString.h: FullRuneInString is like FullRune but its input is a string.

RuneCount.h: RuneCount returns the number of runes in p. Erroneous and short encodings are treated as single runes of width 1 byte.

RuneCountInString.h: RuneCountInString is like RuneCount but its input is a string.

RuneLen.h: RuneLen returns the number of bytes in the UTF-8 encoding of the rune. It returns -1 if the rune is not a valid value to encode in UTF-8.

RuneStart.h: RuneStart reports whether the byte could be the first byte of an encoded, possibly invalid rune. Second and subsequent bytes always have the top two bits set to 10.

Valid.h: Valid reports whether p consists entirely of valid UTF-8-encoded runes.

ValidRune.h: ValidRune reports whether r can be legally encoded as UTF-8. Code points that are out of range or a surrogate half are illegal.

ValidString.h: ValidString reports whether s consists entirely of valid UTF-8-encoded runes.
